integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional representation and exact rational moment proof supplied, with a standalone Python standard-library numerical/checker script. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
limitations: Haar central sections of the equal-edge Euclidean cube; dimension tends to infinity; no uniform finite-dimensional error bound; first-order support and implicit exact finite probabilities are known; historical priority for the sharp two-term rare-event asymptotic is uncertain.
title: Superexponential two-facet deficit of Haar central cube sections
